title: Oldest bands
statementMd:
The five artists formed earliest. Show name and year, ties by name.

Expected columns: `name`, `formed_year`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, formed_year FROM artists ORDER BY formed_year, name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
